text.tspan: A node dies: what Kubernetes does by itself, and what you must design
won't start a 2nd db-0 while the old pod object exists
EBS is AZ-bound, attaches to one node
confirm instance is gone → kubectl delete node <node>
DaemonSets come back on the replacement node by themselves. Default 300 s tolerations come from the DefaultTolerationSeconds
admission plugin, so a short network blip doesn't evict everything.
